already_account: Already have an account? Sign in
reset_password_desc: Enter your email and we’ll send a password-reset link.
interests_sent_hint: Profiles you express interest in will appear here.
interests_mutual_hint: When both members express interest, the match appears here.
shortlist_hint: Save profiles you want to review again.
chat_safety_tips: Keep personal and financial information private until you are comfortable and have verified the other member.
activity_will_appear: Real account and match activity will appear here.
who_viewed_hint: Recent eligible profile views will appear here.
offline_message: You’re offline. Check your connection and try again.
choose_right_plan: Choose a plan based on the contact quota and duration shown by Google Play.
free_biodata_maker: Create a biodata from your Matree profile.
more_languages_after_qa: More languages will appear only after translation and layout QA is complete.
show_partner_summary_title: Show a summary on my profile
show_partner_summary_body: Share only selected expectations such as age, location, marital status, education, occupation, family values and relocation. Sensitive criteria remain private.
shared_preferences_privacy: Only the criteria this member chose to share are shown. Sensitive preferences stay private.
secure_call_eligible: Your relationship is eligible for secure communication.
secure_call_not_mutual: Secure calling unlocks only after both members express interest.
secure_call_blocked: Secure calling is unavailable because this relationship is blocked.
secure_call_privacy: Secure calling is unavailable because a member's privacy settings restrict contact.
secure_call_inactive: Secure calling is unavailable while either account is inactive.
secure_call_invalid: Secure calling is unavailable for this member.
secure_call_unconfirmed: Secure-call eligibility could not be confirmed.
secure_call_provider_pending: Your match is eligible, but live calling is not enabled yet. Matree will not show a fake dialer, relay number, call history or minutes until a real audited provider is connected.
received_interests_hint: New pending requests will appear here after server validation.
interest_intro_help: Add an optional personal introduction. Contact details, external links and payment requests are blocked until you both match.
private_note_only_you: Only you can see this on this app account
report_choose_reason: Choose the reason that best describes the issue.
profile_unavailable_message: This profile is no longer available with your current relationship or privacy state.
blocked_member_notice: You blocked this member. Interests, messaging and contact reveal stay unavailable until you unblock them.
mutual_unlock_notice: Messaging and contact reveal unlock only after both members express interest. You can review this profile and Kundali before accepting or sending interest.
trust_unavailable: Trust Score is temporarily unavailable. Verification badges remain authoritative.
trust_paid_note: Paid membership does not increase Trust Score. Fraud-detection details stay private so they cannot be gamed.
compatibility_disclaimer: Compatibility scores are decision-support signals from the information available in the app; they are not predictions or guarantees about a relationship.
interest_accepted_matched: Interest accepted. You are now matched.
report_failed: Report could not be submitted. Check your connection and try again.
mic_permission_voice: Microphone permission is required for voice messages.
conversation_unavailable_message: This conversation can no longer be opened with your current account or relationship state.
private_chat_safety_notice: Private match conversation. Local message copies are protected on this device; report or block any misuse.
block_member_body: Blocking stops new interactions between you and this member. You can unblock them later.
messaging_mutual_hint: Messaging opens after a mutual interest. Start from the Mutual tab in Interests.
chat_safety_full: Chat safely: never share passwords, OTPs or financial credentials; verify the person and meet first in a public place.
no_conversations_search: No conversations match your current search.
chat_blocked_notice: You blocked this member. Unblock them to continue the conversation.
chat_mutual_required_notice: Messaging is available only after both members accept each other's interest.
chat_respect_notice: Be respectful and avoid sharing sensitive information too early.
both_accept_before_messages: Both members must accept each other's interest before messages can be sent.
search_profiles_hint: Search name, @username, profile ID, job or city
reciprocal_fit: They fit you {they}% • You fit them {you}%
save_search_body: Save the current filters to your account and reuse them on your other signed-in devices.
name: Name
search_preferences_subtitle: State → language → religion → community, plus any other preference you choose.
no_mutual_threshold_profiles: No profiles currently meet your {percent}%+ reciprocal preference threshold. Your strict preferences have not been changed.
no_filter_profiles: No profiles matched your current search settings. Reset or widen them to search a broader eligible set.
no_photo_profiles: No eligible profiles with a photo are available in this result set. You can include profiles without a photo.
no_eligible_profiles: No eligible profiles are available in this result set right now. Try refreshing later.
strict_preference_explanation: Strict preferences exclude profiles in both directions. Preferred preferences improve ordering but do not hide otherwise eligible members.
sensitive_preference_body: Some partner preferences can reveal sensitive personal choices. Enable this only if you want Matree to store and use these preferences for reciprocal discovery. You can withdraw this choice later in Privacy & visibility.
confirmed_religion_notice: Your confirmed profile religion is {religion}. Matching does not use it automatically.
core_preferences_subtitle: Start with the few criteria that matter most. Every item remains optional.
community_faith_subtitle: Use only the religious or community details that matter to you.
location_residence_subtitle: Set geography, citizenship, overseas residence and relocation choices.
language_family_career_subtitle: Refine life-stage, education, work and family-background preferences.
lifestyle_wellbeing_subtitle: Optional lifestyle criteria. Leave them at No preference to keep discovery broad.
choose_option_or_no_preference: Choose at least one option or use No preference.
faith_institution_hint: Optional church, jamaat, samaj or institution
preferences_saved: Partner preferences saved and applied to discovery.
confirmed_religion_preset_ready: Using your confirmed religion as a strict preference. Save to apply it.
profile_religion_missing: Your profile does not have a confirmed religion to use.
enable_sensitive_before_preset: Enable sensitive-preference processing before using this preset.
enable_sensitive_before_saving: Review and enable sensitive-preference processing before saving.
contact_authorized_for_match: Contact access was authorized for your mutual match with {name}.
contact_after_mutual: Contact details become eligible after both members accept each other's interest.
contact_membership_required: An active membership with contact access is required. The server checks your entitlement and quota before returning any phone number.
reveal_shared_phone: Reveal {name}'s shared phone number? This uses your membership contact allowance. Reopening the same contact does not consume another slot.
contact_request_pending: Contact request sent. Waiting for approval.
contact_request_approved: Contact sharing is approved. You can reveal the shared number if your membership allows it.
contact_request_failed: Contact request could not be sent.
contact_requests_body: Approve only members you are comfortable sharing your phone number with. Membership still controls whether they can reveal it.
conversation_starters_body: Choose a starter, edit it if you want, then send it yourself.
conversation_starter_1: Hi! I’m glad we matched. What would you like me to know about you first?
conversation_starter_2: Hello! I enjoyed reading your profile. What matters most to you in a life partner?
conversation_starter_3: Hi! Would you like to start by talking about family, work, interests, or something else?
report_message_body: Choose why this received message should be reviewed. The server preserves the original message evidence for moderation.
message_report_failed: Message report could not be submitted. Check your connection and try again.
chat_preference_failed: Conversation preference could not be updated. Try again.
